```plato

// A spherical panorama camera mapping longitude to X and latitude to Y
// (equirectangular / lat-long; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Equirectangular_projection).
// Sweeps of 360 by 180 degrees capture the whole sphere; smaller sweeps crop it.
type EquirectangularCamera
    implements ICamera
{
    Pose: Pose3D;
    LongitudeSweep: AngleInterval;
    LatitudeSweep: AngleInterval;
    Near: Number;
    Far: Number;
}
```
